stops.note: literally a handing over from, from ex- (out) and tradere (to hand over)
coined in French for the formal surrender of a fugitive to another jurisdiction
stops.meaning: the formal handover of a fugitive between jurisdictions

stops.note: adopted directly for the legal surrender of a fugitive to another country
stops.meaning: the surrender of a fugitive to another jurisdiction

current_meaning: the surrender of a person accused of a crime to the jurisdiction where it occurred
